content:
Setting up coordinates with the table as a 10×6 grid (pockets at the corners), the ball starts at P = (0, 3) moving at 45°, i.e., along the line y = x + 3.

**Unfolding the reflections:** In the unfolded plane, the ball travels along the straight line y = x + 3, and it falls into a pocket only when this line passes through a lattice point of the form (10m, 6n) (images of the corners). This requires:

6n − 10m = 3

But the left side is always even (6n and 10m are both even), while the right side is odd. Hence the line never passes through any image of a corner — the ball can never reach a pocket.

**Checking the trajectory:** Following the bounces (3,6) → (9,0) → (10,1) → (5,6) → (0,1) → (1,0) → (7,6) → (10,3) → (7,0) → (1,6) → (0,5) → (5,0) → (10,5) → (9,6) → (3,0) → back to (0,3) = P, the ball returns to its starting point with its original direction. The motion is a closed cycle that never touches a corner.

Therefore the ball never falls into any pocket; it keeps moving forever.

\boxed{E}
